name: claude-specs
description: Shared Claude Code foundations pulled into other repos: orchestrator agents, universal principles, and a secret-scan hook.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Orchestrator foundations: generic builder/explorer/planner/reviewer agents, a new-project command, a secret-scan hook, and universal working principles.

plugins.name: spec-agentic
plugins.description: Specification doctrine and toolkit for work executed by coding agents: declared-executor headers, a LOCKED/WORKING/OPEN facts ledger, stable anchor IDs with CI verifiers, an OpenAPI contract set, impact maps, and a read-only spec auditor. Pairs with spec-human.

plugins.name: spec-human
plugins.description: Specification doctrine and toolkit for work executed by a human engineering team: what and why not how, length budgets, a machine-tell checklist, the constraint-vs-method cut, ADRs, a sample-chapter-first delivery gate, and a tech-lead-reader audit agent. Pairs with spec-agentic.

plugins.name: ecc
plugins.description: Vendored full copy of affaan-m/ECC v2.0.0 — 64 agents, 262 skills, 84 commands (MIT). Opt-in; mostly language/framework-specific.

plugins.name: ruby
plugins.description: Curated Ruby/Rails/Hotwire/TDD agent skills (28) + a code-reviewer agent, vendored (MIT) from superpowers-ruby + rails-agent-skills + ruby-core-skills. Opt-in; install for Ruby on Rails work.

plugins.name: pm
plugins.description: Vendored copy of phuryn/pm-skills v2.0.0 — 68 product-management skills + 42 commands across discovery, strategy, execution, market research, analytics, GTM, marketing/growth, a toolkit and AI-shipping (MIT). Opt-in; install for product discovery, PRD/spec and roadmap work.

plugins.name: review-council
plugins.description: Always-on multi-persona code-review pipeline: parallel distinct-angle reviewer panels → a Code Review Master → a second adversarial panel → Master 2 → an opt-in Executor & Fixer. No token optimization; every panelist is always spun up. Opt-in.

plugins.name: consulting
plugins.description: Two-phase consulting-grade research reports: Phase 1 designs the analysis framework (chapter skeleton, named frameworks, per-chapter data requirements, visualization plan), other skills collect the data, Phase 2 writes the McKinsey/BCG-voice report with charts and a zero-hallucination policy. Opt-in.
